name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Free Education upto 12th Std. to All
benefit: - Reimbursement: Full reimbursement of tuition fees for students up to the 12th standard.
_eligibility_text:
- The beneficiary should be a Student.
  - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
  - The beneficiary should belong to the Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity community.
  - The beneficiary must be enrolled in a school up to the 12th standard.
